g.text: seal file: inner AEAD, then per-slot outer layer; piece root per slot
MsgCreateDeal (fee burned, escrow = price x replicas x epochs)
slots UNASSIGNED, deal OPEN, assign_at_height = h+1
BeginBlock h+1: picker binds each slot, event storage_slot_assigned
POST /pieces/ROOT (403 until the provider has read the assignment)
Ingest: SHA-256 piece root must equal ROOT; denylist, disk check
slot ACTIVE, deal ACTIVE, challenge for this epoch drawn
closeEpoch: score proved vs missed, mint plan, settlement rows
EndBlock: pay escrow + mint (90% earnings, 5% burn, 5% archive fund)
